As an engine for beginners, it's great. It's straightforward, easy to learn and overall ideal for pouring your imagination out and moulding it into what you want it to be.
It takes a while to get more advanced with it, scripting, managing plugins and the like, but they really do help push the engine to its limits.
And on the topic of limits, if your project is a large one... maybe don't use this engine. When my project was on the smaller side, it ran pretty smoothly, rarely ever causing problems, but as the project got bigger and bolder, crashes have become significantly more frequent, even crashing over the most menial thing like editing text or adding a switch. I'm nearing the end of my project and just doing little bits of polish here and there, trimming fat and adding in some new ideas... but man, does every crash feel like a smack in the face.

Tl:dr, good for small beginner projects, absolute nightmare for large advanced projects.

P.S - download an image editor, really helps on getting the sprites the way you want.

RPG Maker MV est un outil incroyable pour donner vie à ses propres jeux vidéo, même sans aucune expérience en programmation. L’éditeur est simple à prendre en main, les ressources intégrées sont nombreuses, et on peut créer des cartes, des personnages et des systèmes de combat en quelques minutes.

Ce qui rend MV vraiment exceptionnel, c’est sa flexibilité. Les débutants peuvent créer un jeu complet uniquement avec les outils fournis, tandis que les utilisateurs avancés peuvent aller beaucoup plus loin grâce au JavaScript et à une immense bibliothèque de plugins créés par la communauté. On peut littéralement transformer le moteur pour en faire ce qu’on veut.

La compatibilité multiplateforme est un énorme plus : Windows, Mac, Android, iOS, navigateur web… Voir son jeu tourner partout sans effort supplémentaire, c’est extrêmement motivant.

La communauté est l’un des plus grands atouts du logiciel : tutoriels, ressources graphiques, musiques, plugins, entraide… On trouve toujours quelqu’un pour aider ou inspirer.

En bref : RPG Maker MV est un outil puissant, accessible et très inspirant. Parfait pour créer son premier jeu comme pour développer un projet ambitieux. Un must-have pour tous les créateurs en herbe.

Although RPG Maker allows you to create simple games, I cannot recommend this software for three main reasons:

1) LINUX: The Linux version seems to be a second-class citizen. On several occasions I’ve tried to use this software and it simply didn’t work out of the box. In the latest update, the game doesn’t start due to some incompatibility with NWJS. While it’s not impossible to fix, software with a native Linux version should work properly—especially on a popular distribution.

2) PLUGINS and ENGINE: If at any point you want to create JavaScript plugins, the available source code lacks comments, which turns figuring out where to inject functionality into a trial-and-error process. Additionally, they don’t seem to have any issue releasing engine versions that break backward compatibility—breaking your plugins and those from other developers you might be using. The engine version should be tied to the project, not dependent on updates.

3) The included artwork is very limited, and there doesn’t seem to be an easy way to modify the tileset resolution to increase or decrease the resolution per tile.
